CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 13 OF 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 13 OF
2002
REFERENDUM (AMENDMENT) ORDER,
2002
An Order to amend the
Referendum Order, 2002
F.No.2(4)/2002‑Pub.,
dated 25‑4‑2002.‑‑The following order promulgated
by the Chief Executive is hereby published for general information:‑
Whereas it is expedient, to amend
the Referendum Order, 2002, (Chief Executive's Order No'. 12 of 2002), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the, Chief Executive
is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of Emergency of the Fourteenth day of October, 1999, and the
Provisional Constitution Order No. l of 1999, and in exercise of all other
powers enabling him in that behalf, the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic
of .Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate the following Order:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Order may be called the Referendum
(Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed always to have come into force from the 9th April,
2002.

the Referendum Order, 2002, (Chief Executive's Order No'. 12 of 2002), for the

And whereas the, Chief Executive
is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate

Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of Emergency of the Fourteenth day of October, 1999, and the
Provisional Constitution Order No. l of 1999, and in exercise of all other
powers enabling him in that behalf, the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic
of .Pakistan is pleased to make and promulgate the following Order:‑‑
2. Amendment of Article 3,
C.E.O. No.12 of 2002.‑‑In the Referendum Order, 2002 (C. E. O.
No. 12 of 2002), hereinafter referred to as the said Order. in Article 3, in
clause (1), in the proviso, for the full stop ate the end a colon shall be
substituted and thereafter the following further proviso shall be added,
namely:‑‑
"Provided further that where
a citizen is not in possession of a National Identity Card, he may produce
before the Presiding Officer any of the following documents duly attested and
stamped to prove his age and bearing his attested photograph to establish his
identity namely:--
(i) his service card issued by
his employer,
(ii) his International Passport
or an Aqama issued by a foreign sponsor or employer to be Pakistani expatriate
in lieu of his passport;
(iii) his motor vehicle driving
licence issued by a competent authority;
(iv) a certificate issued by the
head of an educational institution, principal, headmaster or a lecturer
thereof:
(v) a certificate issued
Government official in Basic Pay Scale 17 or above; or
(vi) a certificate issued by a
Nazim or Naib Nazim of a Local Government.
